purpose: First live validation of intake methodology — represents brand decisions without inventing final logo/color/type outputs.

interpreted_fields.business_definition: Brokerage and back-office for owner-operators and small fleets — business office behind the truck.
interpreted_fields.customer_need: Keep moving parts connected: compliance, cash flow, operations while on the road.
interpreted_fields.business_model_context: Shipper → AIO → private carrier board (not open marketplace).

interpreted_fields.differentiation: Operational back-office integrated with road reality vs generic software or load boards.

interpreted_fields.functional_promise: Connected operations from startup through every mile after.
interpreted_fields.emotional_promise: Calm control while the business keeps moving.

voice_genome.contextual_modulation: Road-office character is selective — not constant punning.

prohibited_language: constant road puns on every line
interpreted_fields.industry_lexicon: Fluent logistics/operations terms when accurate — not buzzword soup.

founder_decisions.positioning_line: THE BUSINESS OFFICE BEHIND THE TRUCK.
founder_decisions.product_promise: FROM STARTUP TO EVERY MILE AFTER.
secondary_brand_lines: ONE OFFICE. THE WHOLE ROAD AHEAD.
YOUR BUSINESS HAS MOVING PARTS. WE KEEP THEM CONNECTED.

IDNTY_06_VERBAL_SYSTEM.note: Lines are SITE 00 synthesis output — intake questions supply signals, not client-written final copy.

interpreted_fields.name_equity: Company name carries significant equity — symbol must work with wordmark.
interpreted_fields.symbolic_requirements: May symbolize connection, route, or office-truck unity — not cliché truck clip art.

IDNTY_07_MARK.note: Logo exploration deferred to post-methodology sprint.

interpreted_fields.emotional_temperature: Professional, trustworthy, road-capable — not neon tech or grimy grit.
industry_color_cliches: Overused red/white/blue fleet tropes without meaning

IDNTY_08_PALETTE.note: No final hex values claimed in this sprint.

interpreted_fields.document_behavior: Invoices, compliance, and correspondence must be legible.

interpreted_fields.brand_world: American road + business office — asphalt, paper, cab, dispatch.
interpreted_fields.documentary_vs_commercial: Leans documentary operational truth with professional polish.

validation_notes: All 12 dimensions represented with structured fields.
Verbal system uses founder-approved lines as decisions, not client questionnaire output.
Mark/palette/type remain intentionally unresolved for mark development sprint.
